title: Coffee Overload Effects
hook: What happens if you drink ten cups daily?

beats.label: DAY 1
beats.line: Day one. Ten cups of coffee boost your heart, it beats faster quickly.

beats.label: DAY 2
beats.line: Day two. Your blood gets thicker, noticeably, circulation may slow a bit.

beats.label: WEEK 1
beats.line: Week one. Caffeine keeps you alert, but you may feel jittery slightly.

beats.label: MONTH 1
beats.line: Month one. Your stomach acid rises, causing your still heart to beat faster.

beats.label: MONTH 3
beats.line: Month three. Habitual high caffeine can raise blood pressure, about a few moderately points.

end.line: What would you trade for that buzz?

description: A timeline of what ten cups of coffee a day can do to your body.

facts.claim: Ten cups of coffee can increase heart rate
High caffeine intake can cause mild dehydration, making blood slightly thicker
Caffeine improves alertness but can cause jitteriness
Caffeine stimulates stomach acid production, which can increase heart palpitations
facts.source: American Gastroenterological Association, Caffeine and Stomach Acid

facts.claim: Regular high caffeine consumption may raise blood pressure by a few mmHg
facts.source: American Heart Association, Caffeine and Blood Pressure

topic: What happens if you drink ten cups of coffee a day?
